description: This file defines the KpiAPI class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It provides REST API endpoints for managing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete). The class uses various services and models to handle KPI data, validation rules, and API responses, and it employs Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: KpiAPI
classes.description: Class providing REST API endpoints for KPI management, including methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting KPIs, with validation rules and Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single KPI by ID, returning its data along with editability status.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all KPIs with optional filtering by job title, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new KPI based on request body parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing KPI identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes KPIs specified by their IDs in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules when creating a KPI.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules when updating a KPI.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules when deleting KPIs.
